items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: he told me how to learn how to play drums... 'Son, you might go far. Don't make that mistake no more.'

ctx.x: Ringling Brothers, Barnum and Bailey and whatever you read about Ringling Brothers, Barnum and Bailey they have to have crack Johnson there in his picture, a black man. He looked like Jack Johnson. But the drummer I spoke about, nobody in the whole world has ever played that much drums, because I forgot that I had met the man and years later I did a faux pas. I made a boo-boo. I did something wrong and this man came several years later and sat down at the drums where I was playing and he said, 'Son, you might go…
